changes.details: End-to-end acceptance integration suite covering complete lifecycle (visitor submit -> partner receive -> contacted -> confirmed -> visitor tracking), strict multi-tenant isolation across partner accounts, zero PII disclosure, and negative abuse guardrails.

acceptance_criteria: Real visitor submits -> partner receives -> contacted -> confirmed -> status updated: VERIFIED
Multi-tenant isolation: Partner B sees zero inquiries from Partner A: VERIFIED
Cross-tenant mutation attempt rejected with 403 FORBIDDEN_SCOPE: VERIFIED
Invalid transition jumps return 400 RBPC_INVALID_TRANSITION: VERIFIED
Zero synthetic booking, fake partner or mock payment in any production path: VERIFIED
